reason: Strong cost-matched uniform controls beat high-dimensional gates at moderate budgets. Test whether honest low-dimensional score disagreement predicts depth returns better.
training_features: Predictions of base scorers excluding the entire training animal, with HPO repeated after its exclusion. Validation/test use fitted full-training base scorers. No future depth action score is observed by the gate.
target: Same strict cross-animal action-specific absolute-error reductions saved in experiment34; all models and data identical.
paid_probe: One depth frame for every event at a positive feasible cap, including those whose final score reverts to RGB; no hidden extra inference.
standardisation: Mean and standard deviation of training gate features only; constant columns divide by1
selection: Same 15-point gate grid and mean validation MAE at .25/.5/.75 caps; linear alternative uses ridge alpha .01/.1/1/10/100 with an unpenalised intercept
split_history: Uses all three stored repeated splits. Further source exploration after observing earlier outcomes; not a fresh independent validation set.
